prompt.title: Start the tutorial?
prompt.body: We can walk you through the basics of this site.

steps.step1: Pick a tool or mini game from the home page.
steps.step2: Use the quick search (Ctrl+K / Cmd+K) to jump between pages.
steps.step3: Try the BGM player for playlists and playback controls.
steps.step4: Use BGM DJ to mix with two decks and a crossfader.
steps.step5: Play the BGM quiz mini game for a quick challenge.
